    Powering Formula 1®: Driving broadcast innovation worldwide

    From trackside to screen. Ultra-low latency for an unparalleled fan experience.

    Key challenges What we do Customer Stories Industry validation Resources Get Started

    Formula 1® : A singularly demanding arena

    1
    Multi-channel output

    Over 90 video feeds & 150 audio channels operate simultaneously each F1® race weekend.

    2
    A universal audience

    2.06Bn cumulative audience, 86Mn average viewers per race globally.

    3
    A global sport

    24 races across 21 countries on 5 continents

    4
    Remote operations

    Race data must travel from circuit to UK op centre for global broadcast.

    5
    Dependable agility

    Reaction time is milliseconds, not seconds. Speed defines success.

    Our tech & talent: Fueling F1® success

    Innovation
    Innovation
    Speed and Agility
    Sustainability
    Trust
    Engineering Excellence

    Bringing global F1® action to fans with ultra-low latency broadcasts

    Our innovative remote broadcast solution lets F1®'s production team work from a central UK hub. We stream critical race data from 24 global locations in under 200 milliseconds to UK, then deliver it to millions of fans worldwide. This seamless, ultra-low latency workflow brings every thrilling moment to screens globally.

    Relentless pace: Building and breaking down F1® broadcasts globally

    At each of the 24 global F1® races, come rain or shine, we build, test, and transmit 90 video and 150 audio feeds, delivering over 500TB of data every weekend. We then expertly dismantle, transport, and rebuild this entire setup on another continent within a week. Unwavering precision, relentless pace.

    Driving efficiency and sustainability with remote operations

    Our global network empowered F1® to launch its remote operations model in 2020. This transformation significantly reduced at-track production scale and cut traveling freight, demonstrating how our technology drives efficiency and sustainability for the sport.

    F1®'s trusted partner: Delivering uninterrupted race broadcasts since 2012

    Since 2012, F1® trusts Tata Communications and our dedicated on-site engineers for unparalleled service at every race. We ensure 86 million fans never miss a second of the action, delivering seamless, uninterrupted broadcast from track to screen.

    100G network keeps pace with the world's fastest sport

    Our 100G fiber network, purpose-built for F1®, combined with a committed on-site service team at every race, ensures Tata Communications keeps pace with the world's fastest sport.
